caption:
The owners weren't built in the 1700s.

An opening "Built in..." phrase has to land on the thing that was built. A possessive in front doesn't fix it.

Comment the wrong word before you check.
tiktok_caption: Built in the 1700s... the owners? Nope. The mill.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Dangling Modifier With Built In
youtube.description: Spot the error: an opening past-participle phrase attached to the wrong noun. SAT-style practice question (original).
